user.title: Connect to Grafana
user.description: Enter the address and login for your Grafana server.

ha_connection.title: Connection back to Home Assistant
ha_connection.description: Grafana needs to be able to pull location data from Home Assistant. Enter the URL Grafana can reach Home Assistant on, and a Long-Lived Access Token (create one under your profile in Home Assistant).

dashboard.title: Choose dashboard
dashboard.description: Pick an existing Grafana dashboard to add the location panels to, or create a new one.

data.dashboard_title: Name for new dashboard (if creating one)

error.datasource_failed: Could not create/find the datasource in Grafana. Make sure the 'Infinity' plugin (yesoreyeram-infinity-datasource) is installed.
error.dashboard_failed: Could not create or update the dashboard in Grafana.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one connection to Grafana can be configured.
